_help: Settings for the Houston cash tracker. Edit on GitHub (pencil icon) and commit; the next run uses them.
_exclude_help: Rooms PokerAtlas files under a Houston area that aren't really in Houston. Any room whose web address (slug) contains one of these words is skipped.
_extra_help: Rooms to always include even if PokerAtlas doesn't list them under a Houston area. Find the vid by opening the room on PokerAtlas and clicking 'View Live Info' - the number at the end of the web address.
_stale_help: If a room hasn't updated PokerAtlas in this many minutes, its tables are shown but not counted in totals or charts.
